subject: CAIQ rapid-response: attachment grooming and evidence sprint
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice@northstar.health>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: AuditDesk <auditdesk@acmeaudit.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ: expedited evidence request for upcoming audit

Hi Irene,

We're in the final prep window for our CSA CAIQ review and Acme Audit is asking for an expedited package of controls and supporting artifacts that map to the CAIQ IDs we flagged in last week's scan. The auditor list includes a few high-priority controls around key management, tenant isolation, and runtime telemetry.

Can you: 
- Provide a control crosswalk (CAIQ ID -> Redwood control/owner)
- Attach the keystore rotation policy and a sample key rotation event log
- Share a brief note about runtime telemetry retention and a pointer to sample runtime logs (anonymized is fine)

We're hoping to have the package delivered by end of week (Fri). If you need an NDA/DocuSign first, let me know and I can route it today.

Thanks,
Alice Wu
Security Manager, NorthStar Health
alice@northstar.health

--
Attachments requested: keystore policy, sample rotation log, control crosswalk
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice@northstar.health>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, AuditDesk <auditdesk@acmeaudit.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: expedited evidence request for upcoming audit

Alice — thanks for the heads up. We can support an expedited package.

Proposed plan:
- Quick internal sprint (Aug 20-21) to groom attachments and produce a CAIQ crosswalk.
- Kimberly will assemble the control map and core artifacts.
- Marissa will handle DocuSign/NDA and secure artifact transfer (SFTP).

Questions for you:
1) Confirm scope — are we limited to the 15 controls flagged in your scan or should we include the full CCM domains that touch key management and telemetry?
2) Any special redaction rules for user data in runtime logs?

If you can confirm NDA routing preference (DocuSign or our secure portal), we'll provision an upload bucket and an ownership roster so the auditor can pick samples.

I attached a short checklist in the thread (initial_control_map.csv) to make sure owners know what's needed.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
